description:
Get moves between providers

The from→to matrix of participants that changed Access Point provider in a trailing window: who lost participants to whom, for the whole network, in one call. The `top` largest providers on each side keep their identity (`from` = sources, `to` = destinations; a provider can be on both). Every other provider folds into one "Other" node per side, and `other` gives the number of folded providers and their participants.

`pairs` is the COMPLETE folded matrix, largest first: a `null` `from` or `to` is the "Other" node of that side, zero cells are omitted, and the values sum to `total` exactly. A node's `value` is all its moves in the window, also the moves to or from a folded provider.

A move inside one provider (between two of its own Access Points) is not counted. Every day is the PROBE-OBSERVATION day — when the change scan saw the SMP record change — not the day a migration was executed. A window with no moves returns `total: 0` and empty lists.

PLATFORM MOVES. A mover is a platform move when the platform that serves the participant stayed and only the certificate Seat changed: it is not a customer decision. The verdict is per DIRECTED provider pair (from → to), over all its movers since 2026-08-02, with one of two reasons (`same_host`, `sub_provider`): at least 90% of the movers whose endpoint host can be compared (5 or more, and at least 50% of all movers of the pair) kept their endpoint host, or at least 90% of 25 or more movers still carry, at the new provider, the sub-provider brand of the provider they left. It is a CURRENT judgment, computed again on every rollup cycle. The movers of a platform-move pair are in no node, in no cell and not in `total`: `platform` gives their number and the number of directed provider pairs they come from. The matrix has Providers only; a Vendor is not in it.

`country_share` gives the movers of one country (FR) among all movers of the window that have a country. The matrix has no country filter; this share includes the platform moves.

days.description: The trailing window in days, ending today (UTC).

top.description: How many providers keep their identity on each side. The matrix has at most `(top + 1)²` cells.

name: get_provider_moves
